# Karpo Travel Inc.

> Personalized travel agency based in Bellmore, New York. Remote planning for travelers. Your Journey, Our Priority.

Karpo Travel Inc. plans flights, hotels, vacations, cruises, car rentals, and visa assistance. The practice draws on over 60 years of family experience in the travel industry. Clients can call or WhatsApp 24/7.
